text: PR #1 qualification found two remaining issues. Full local studioAll reached an outdated docs/studio/a11y/tab-order-analysis.txt preset breadcrumb snapshot; family breadcrumb is the intended replacement. Original push Studio CI jobs hit heap OOM in native artifact JSON resolution (both macOS and Linux), then timed out at 60 minutes. studioFxTestOptions sets no explicit fork heap, so sbt -J-Xmx only configures the parent JVM while fork heap is machine-dependent. Local test JVM has ample ergonomic heap and native command journeys passed. Investigating runner memory and an explicit test-JVM heap before rerunning CI; no weakening test assertions or timeouts planned.
